source_document: Development of Greenspace Standard Index — Interim Report v2
author: 56 Degree Insight, commissioned by Outscape
survey: People in the Outdoors Monitor for Northern Ireland (POMNI), 2025 wave
status: Interim study. This is a PROPOSED survey-based index under review by Outscape, not an adopted statutory greenspace standard.
measurement_basis: All results reflect POMNI respondents' PERCEPTIONS of their local greenspaces (POMNI Q14 and Q15), not objective measures of greenspace provision.

reporting_threshold.note: Postcode areas/sectors with <30 respondents are excluded from the report. Even above the threshold, results identify broad geographic patterns rather than precise differences between individual areas.

margins_of_error_95pct.note: Typically <1% of the population sampled in each area.

score_formats.percentage: Score as % of the maximum possible score (100% = highest possible).
score_formats.index: Score relative to the Northern Ireland population average, where 100 = NI average; 110 ≈ 10% above average, 90 ≈ 10% below average.
score_formats.decile: Areas ranked highest→lowest and split into ten equal groups; proposed in the report for mapping/differentiation. No decile values are published in this report, so none are extracted.
